newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb kills four people outside Algiers school.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills four people outside Algiers school.

text.p: A bomb killed four people and wounded 21, many of them schoolchildren, in Algiers on Tuesday, the security forces said.
"The dead are three schoolchildren and a child," the forces said in a statement read out on Algerian state radio.
The three schoolchildren were all girls, aged between 15 and 18, according to the statement. The child, a boy, was aged 12.
"Six among the wounded are in a serious state," the statement said.
The authorities have blamed Moslem fundamentalists fighting to topple the government for previous bomb attacks.
The bomb was a "booby-trapped parcel hidden under a car parked outside Frantz Fanon high school in Bab El-Oued", the statement said.
